records.evidence: Versioned response, rubric, assessor identity/role, source snapshot, score, critical errors and fresh transfer task. P01 defines fields, not an application learner model.
records.retry: Preserve earlier attempt; targeted remediation; unseen variant. No completion by attendance or investment returns.
records.calibration: 85% is an inherited pedagogical default, not psychometrically validated certification. P17 pilots must evaluate item reliability and accessibility.
